name: Fused Sparse Voxel Volume Rendering Backward Pass
definition: The backward pass for the fused sparse voxel volume rendering, computing gradients for SH coefficients and spherical harmonics basis values, with support for beta loss and sparsity loss.
summary: The fused sparse voxel volume rendering backward pass computes gradients for spherical harmonics and regularization terms using a fused kernel to optimize memory bandwidth and throughput for sparse voxel grids.
